retrieval_text:
INCIDENT TYPE:
ACTIVE DIRECTORY COMPROMISE

DESCRIPTION:
Active Directory compromise occurs when attackers gain control of domain resources, privileged accounts, or domain controllers, enabling widespread access across the enterprise.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1484 | Domain Policy Modification

INDICATORS:
- Unauthorized GPO changes
- New privileged accounts
- Kerberos anomalies
- Domain Controller access

DETECTION RULES:
- Privileged group changes
- Kerberos anomalies
- GPO modifications

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- Domain Controllers
- Active Directory
- Enterprise systems
title: ACTIVE DIRECTORY COMPROMISE
